items.prompt: Edit this aquarium backdrop ONLY in color palette. Preserve the exact composition, all shell arches, crescent pearls, ribbon plants, open central swimming space, caustics, light beams, painterly texture, brightness, aspect ratio and absence of animals/text. Shift the currently warm blush-pink water and overall lighting toward a slightly more purple soft lavender/lilac palette. Make the lilac hue clearly noticeable but gentle: pale wisteria water, lavender-pink plants, pearl highlights with a little blush pink still present. Keep it luminous pastel and tender, not saturated neon, not dark violet, not blue. This is Lunea's pale pink lullaby, now with more lavender. No new objects or layout changes.
